thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'skyline-prod' reported repeated GPU ECC errors and a soft power cycle on node gpu-42. Impact: up to 15% tail-latency increase for SkylineCorp tenant, automatic drain recommended. (alert id: ib-20260315-924)

sam_oncall: got paged by the bot — seeing the ECC count spike in metrics and node shows degraded PCI link. I'm starting the drain now. @mel_eng_sre you're on deck if it escalates.

mel_eng_sre: on it. can you paste the node state and recent logs? I'll stand up replacement if the node doesn't recover.

sam_oncall: logs snippet below — happened ~3x in the last 10 minutes.

```
[03:14:02] pci-e: link retrain
[03:14:09] nvlink: ecc: 0x7ff -> corrected
[03:14:37] thermal: sensor mismatch, fan 3 reported 99% but pwm unchanged
[03:20:11] kernel: GPU0 ECC uncorrectable error count++
```

anya_runtime: routing shows SkylineCorp traffic is pinned to skyline-prod dedicated pool with failover set to 'hosted-lowcost'. Failover thresholds haven't triggered yet; draining node should reduce requeues.

lia_csm: lia here — I already messaged the SkylineCorp SRE Slack channel (they're monitoring). They reported a small uptick in 5xx for their short-chat route but no full outage. They asked for ETA and whether we can avoid a full tenant migration.

devon_support: customer impact note: affected model: gpt-small-stream-v2 (quantized) used by SkylineCorp's conversational webhook. Throughput degradation mostly on samples > 1k tokens. Suggest we avoid immediate model swap to prevent regressions.

sam_oncall: running drain command now, will cordon and live-migrate active sessions off gpu-42.

```
# drain node
rcli node cordon --pool skyline-prod --node gpu-42
rcli node drain --pool skyline-prod --node gpu-42 --grace 120
```

ops-bot: acknowledged. Eviction started for 12 worker processes. Estimated completion 2m.

mel_eng_sre: watching eviction. If any sessions stall, we'll trigger fallback routing per runbook 7.2. I have a quick patch to reduce batch packing on the remaining nodes to relieve pressure.

sam_oncall: eviction completed, node marked unschedulable. However, host-level metrics show sustained GPU memory errors, advising replacement. Annotating node: hardware_fault=memory-controller

anya_runtime: automatically routed new SkylineCorp requests to dedicated pool instances gpu-12/gpu-19/gpu-24. We're seeing higher CPU usage on those hosts; lowering batch size for skyline-prod fleet by 30% to keep latency SLO.

devon_support: lia — tell SkylineCorp: we drained a problematic node and routed traffic away, no tenant-wide migration. Expected tail latency to normalize in 5-10 minutes. I'll keep them updated.

lia_csm: thanks — they're OK with that for now but asked about root cause and permanent fix timeline.

mel_eng_sre: next steps: 1) isolate node for replacement (RMA), 2) schedule hardware swap in on-prem region (APAC) — may take 6-12 hrs depending on parts, 3) if it's a transient spot eviction we should note it.

ryan_infra: quick note — GPU instance shows irregular cloud provider soft-reboot events; metadata indicates host host123 had two GC events in last 24h. Could be datacenter power island flapping. I'm opening a provider ticket.

sam_oncall: handoff to mel for overnight follow-up. mel, I'm leaving a checklist in the channel: drain done, node unschedulable, traffic rerouted, customer notified. If you need to escalate to infra, ping @ryan_infra.

mel_eng_sre: acknowledged handoff. I'll stay on for the next 2hrs and then hand to the night shift if unresolved. Adding a mitigation: pin SkylineCorp to an alternate dedicated pool 'skyline-failover' for higher isolation until the node is RMA'd.

```
# pin tenant to alternate pool
rcli route update --tenant skylinecorp --primary-pool skyline-failover --sticky 3600
```

anya_runtime: applied route change; in-flight sessions continue on current hosts until finish, new sessions go to failover. Telemetry now shows SkylineCorp 99th p95 normalizing.

devon_support: customer acknowledged pin and asked for weekly postmortem. Lia will coordinate.

lia_csm: scheduling postmortem with SkylineCorp for tomorrow 11:00 PDT. I'll include metrics, timeline, and our mitigation steps.

mel_eng_sre: filing incident and RMA ticket. Adding tags: dedicated_pool, hardware_fault, tenant_isolation, skylinecorp. Will update when provider responds.

ops-bot: incident recorded as INC-20260315-324. Current severity: Sev3 (partial degradation, customer alerts but no outage).

sam_oncall: thanks everyone. mel — handoff complete, you're primary now. I'm available if you need me.

mel_eng_sre: thanks — will follow up with provider ticket number and RMA ETA. Closing slack thread after postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: automated note: please run the dedicated-pool health audit for skyline-prod within 24h: `scripts/dedpool-health --pool skyline-prod --report`
